notes: 11 WebSearch calls attempted (1 returned a usage-limit error and was repeated), 2 held in reserve. Search summaries blend pages, so attributions are to the page named in the summary. Doubts: (1) NHS pages differ on Fournier's gangrene (main page: 999; side-effects page: tell doctor or 111 straight away); both are now stated. (2) 'Not suitable at higher DKA risk' and 'usually for life' come from search summaries of NHS pages. (3) Gateshead Health and East Kent Hospitals leaflets are NHS trust pages (not in the usual host list) used for SGLT2-inhibitor class and UTI risk; the UTI sentence could be dropped if the maintainer wants NHS.uk-only sourcing. (4) SmPC statements (thiazide/loop diuretics) came from a search summary of the emc SmPC; the SmPC breastfeeding statement and leaflet DKA risk-factor list were never retrieved and were cut. (5) The ketone/'unsafe' wording of c13/c43/c71 originally lacked a 999 route. (6) Monitoring field is thin (NICE TA773 only). (7) 'updated' key removed: no entity in content/medications.json uses it; docs/authoring/README.md says to set it, so the maintainer should confirm check_batch accepts the fragment without it. (8) Dose/eGFR figures seen in search results were deliberately not used. (9) Doses, cut-offs and schedules: none in published text.
